SET @prov_c := '%s';
SET	@id := '%s';
SET @cat_id := '%s';
SET	@send :=  IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2);
SET	@b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1);
SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001');
SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_colon_screen_w(
  id varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL,
  areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL,
  flag_sent varchar(1) NOT NULL,
  date_com varchar(14) NOT NULL,
  b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL,
  	
	fitposq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	fitposq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	fitposq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
	fitposq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

  fitnegq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  fitnegq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  fitnegq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0,
  fitnegq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0,

PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year),
	KEY (hospcode),
	KEY (areacode),
	KEY (b_year)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;

DELETE FROM s_colon_screen_w WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543);
INSERT IGNORE INTO s_colon_screen_w
(
SELECT @id,h.hoscode ,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as d_com,@b_year+543
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0061'),t.cid,NULL))  AS posq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0061'),t.cid,NULL))  AS posq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0061'),t.cid,NULL))  AS posq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0061'),t.cid,NULL))  AS posq4

,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(10,11,12) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0060'),t.cid,NULL))  AS negq1
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(1,2,3) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0060'),t.cid,NULL))  AS negq2
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(4,5,6) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0060'),t.cid,NULL))  AS negq3
,COUNT(DISTINCT IF(DATE_FORMAT(t.date_year2,'%m') IN(7,8,9) AND t.f_year2 in('1B0060'),t.cid,NULL))  AS negq4

FROM
t_fit_test_hosp t
INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode = h.hoscode
INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON t.hospcode=p.hospcode AND t.pid=p.pid
WHERE t.f_year2 IN('1B0060','1B0061')  AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(year,p.BIRTH,t.date_year2) BETWEEN 50 AND 70
AND t.date_year2 BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d  AND p.nation IN(99) AND p.discharge IN(9)
GROUP BY h.hoscode 
);

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, SUM( "fitposq1" + "fitposq2" + "fitposq3" + "fitposq4" + "fitnegq1" + "fitnegq2" + "fitnegq3" + "fitnegq4" ) target, SUM("fitnegq1" + "fitnegq2" + "fitnegq3" + "fitnegq4") fitneg, SUM("fitposq1" + "fitposq2" + "fitposq3" + "fitposq4") result, SUM("fitposq1" + "fitnegq1") resultq1, SUM("fitposq2" + "fitnegq2") resultq2, SUM("fitposq3" + "fitnegq3") resultq3, SUM("fitposq4" + "fitnegq4") resultq4, SUM("fitposq1") "fitposq1", SUM("fitposq2") "fitposq2", SUM("fitposq3") "fitposq3", SUM("fitposq4") "fitposq4", SUM("fitnegq1") "fitnegq1", SUM("fitnegq2") "fitnegq2", SUM("fitnegq3") "fitnegq3", SUM("fitnegq4") "fitnegq4" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode AND s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} ) AND ( h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) ) AND ( h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) ) AND ( h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) AND ( ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} ) AND ( cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code
